description: This is a wide, multi-lane road with a landscaped median and roadside planting strips that provide some separation from traffic, but there is no clearly visible dedicated sidewalk along the roadway in this view. The road surface appears smooth and well maintained, with streetlights and scattered trees offering limited shade, while the open, high-speed roadway and lack of visible curb ramps, crosswalks, or other pedestrian accessibility features reduce walkability.
